t: This is Liberty Grip, a bronze sculpture from 2008 by the English artist Gary Hume. It stands on a riverside path on the east side of The O2 at North Greenwich. It's part of The Line, a public art trail that very roughly follows the path of the Prime Meridian as it crosses the Thames. Hume's work is strongly identified with the Young British Artists who came to prominence in the early 1990s. He lives and works in London and in New York.
